safe_custom_abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health redesign audit (owner-approved 2026-09-28)
safe_custom_abilities.exact_effect: The first time the user falls below 50% HP, it gains +1 Attack and +1 Speed. For the next 3 turns, its damaging moves deal 10% more damage, and each direct damaging move it uses causes recoil equal to 10% of its max HP.

safe_custom_abilities.restrictions: The 3-turn damage/recoil window begins on activation. Recoil applies only after the user's direct damaging moves; status moves do not cause recoil.

safe_custom_abilities.restrictions: Does not trigger from poison, burn, weather, hazards, recoil, self-KO effects, temporary revival effects, or other indirect KOs. Retaliation is nonlethal and leaves the attacker at a minimum of 1 HP.
